decision.child_flags: Molecule/reaction obj.mit_enabled assignments propagate the existing core flag and do not enable the network.
decision.cold_normal_branch: Both actual callers omit mit_enabled, so its literal False default reaches the sole core flag assignment. read_substances therefore publishes core.mit=None and no mitochondrial mapping.
decision.configuration: Both mol_mit_enabled parameter assignments are False. The commented enable-mitochondria config read has no runtime effect and neither actual constructor passes that parameter.
decision.future_scope: A source variation explicitly threading True into the actual owner constructor, or an authenticated externally preenabled snapshot, requires a separately named boundary. Neither is represented as native cold reachability here.
decision.normal_dispatch: Actual normal solver dispatch reaches the network, but does not enable mitochondria. Existing GRN dispatch is not mitochondrial execution credit.
decision.reinitialize: Wrapper reinitialize methods refresh network properties on the existing core; there is no core flag write. redefine_dynamic_dics constructs Mito only under an already-true core flag.
decision.restart_boundary: Original loadSim/pickles.load may deserialize a preenabled object. This audit does not rule out arbitrary externally prepared state; no authenticated built-in cold producer for such an enabled object was found. Loading alone does not establish its provenance.
decision.unused_systems_class: The separate math.systems.SimMaster constructor also has a False default, but no call to SimMaster occurs in the parsed BETSE package; it is not a replacement for MasterOfNetworks.

existing_component_boundary.credit: No new combined solver, physical/energy/fuel, ECM/fluid/cut or mitochondrial network qualification credit.
existing_component_boundary.network_order_if_enabled: clear_run_loop zeroes extra_rho_mit; tissue_init balances cell then environment then mitochondrial counterions; run_loop commits molecular mitochondrial reactions, accumulates molecular rho without scale_factor, computes energy_charge, conditionally publishes simulator charge/current, copies extra_rho_mit to mit.extra_rho, then calls Mito.update.
existing_component_boundary.organelle_order: Constructor snapshots half volume/area and copies cytosolic ions without refreshing zero Q/V or defining extra_rho. update mutates moving ions in source order from incoming Vmit, then refreshes charge/voltage once.
existing_component_boundary.reuse: Isolated cached-voltage/ordered-ion/charge component only, conditional on an explicit owner and supplied external charge density.
